primary_goal: Complete useful already-catalogued content as reusable native Unreal assets for applicable Unreal systems generally.
primary_technical_evidence: exact canonical identity and native object path/package revision
native class, valid mesh geometry, dimensions and authored pivot
native material slots and texture/dependency closure
named save and persistence/reopen evidence where authorized
optional_consumer_history_preserved: per-feature measurements and garage-frame fit rejections
work_priority: Existing catalog useful contents first. Do not start new broad candidate acquisition or semantic jobs. Existing180-candidate queue is retained history/future input, not a new work order.
preservation: All named holds/rights/vendor/source/native preservation and one-writer boundaries remain. Native technical presence does not release selection holds or grant rights.
